product.title: Oahu: Chief's Luau Admission Including Transfers

description.text: Chief's Luau includes pickup at the hotel, a lei and cocktail greeting, Hawaiian food, and a live Polynesian show. The meal is an all-you-can-eat buffet, and headband weaving is one of the activities during the evening. Round-trip transfers from the hotel are provided, and more than one package is offered. Headband weaving sits with the buffet and the Polynesian show after the hotel transfer on Oahu. Packages differ, but the hotel transfer, lei, cocktail, buffet, and live Polynesian show are the evening's core on Oahu.
